subject: VM evidence: scan cadence, SLA statement and remediation ownership
messages:
From: Sarah Liu <sarah.liu@auditsuite.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 11 Jul 2025 08:14:00 -0700
Subject: Request: VM evidence for SIG/SOC2 - scan cadence + remediation records

Hi Jonas,

We're working through FinLender's SIG/SOC 2 evidence collection and need the vulnerability management artifacts you maintain for Redwood's hosted runtime used by FinLender (account: FinLender Inc.). Specifically could you provide:

- A scan index showing the cadence (last 6 months) and the dates of each full/partial scan.
- Proof of remediation or tracking for critical and high CVEs affecting the runtime (patch manifest or ticket IDs).
- Your SLA definition for CVE remediation windows (critical/high/medium/low) we can include in the SOC2 binder.
- A short attestation (1-2 sentences) that for Critical CVEs affecting production P0/P1 services, a patch/fix is applied or mitigated within your committed SLA or an approved exception exists.

If possible, we'd like the files or a secure link by end of day Tuesday (2025-07-15). Attachments are fine, or a shared Drive/S3 link works.

Thanks,
Sarah
Sarah Liu
Audit Lead, AuditSuite
[signed]

Attachments requested: none (see list above)

Monica / Kim / Markus,

FYI - FinLender audit team asks for the last 6 months of VM evidence and an explicit SLA attestation. Can you pull:

1) scan index export for May/Jun 2025 + rolling cadence (CSV)
2) patch manifest that ties CVE IDs to ticket numbers or build hashes (zip ok)
3) formal SLA PDF we maintain for SOC2 binder
4) a one-line attestation for "Critical CVEs applied or mitigated within committed SLA" that I can send back to Sarah.

Plan: Monica, can you assemble the bundle and upload to the secure S3 folder below? Kim, please confirm the SLA language is the current one (no outstanding exceptions). Markus, flag any open exceptions for FinLender's prod scope.

I'll review before sending.

Thanks,
Jonas

Redwood Inference

From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Cc: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 11 Jul 2025 15:46:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Request: VM evidence for SIG/SOC2 - scan cadence + remediation records

Jonas / team,

Uploading the bundle now. Summary below and attachments uploaded to s3://redwood-secuments/finlender/2025-07/ (link in metadata).

What I attached:
- vm_scan_index_202506.csv (rows: scan_id,date,type,scope,critical_count,high_count)
- patch_manifest_202506.zip (contains: ticket mappings, build hashes, remediation notes)
- sla-declaration-2025-07.pdf (current SLA language; signed by Security Ops)

Quick answers:
- Scan cadence: weekly full scans for infra targets (Monday 0300 UTC), daily critical-target delta scans (03:00 UTC), manual ad-hoc scans triggered on high-risk code or dependency updates. The CSV shows the last 26 scan rows.
- SLA windows: Critical = 30 days from disclosure (or 48 hours to deploy emergency mitigations if actively exploited); High = 90 days; Medium = 180 days; Low = next regular release. This is the language in sla-declaration-2025-07.pdf.
- Remediation ownership: For the FinLender tenant we operate a named-owner model — Security Ops owns triage and patch routing; infra owners own rollout. The patch_manifest maps CVE->ticket->owner.

Open items:
- There are 2 high findings in May that are assigned but on a staged rollout; both have tickets recorded in the manifest (tickets: INF-2345, APP-4290). No outstanding criticals in the past 90 days.

Attestation text (draft):
"Redwood Inference attests that, for production-impacting Critical CVEs affecting FinLender workloads, remediation or emergency mitigation is applied within our documented SLA (Critical: 30 days or emergency mitigations within 48 hours in actively exploited cases). Where exceptions are approved, they are tracked and documented in the patch manifest."

If that wording looks good I'll send to Sarah and attach the files.

Thanks,
Monica Patel
Sr. Security Program Manager
Redwood Inference

Subject: Re: Request: VM evidence for SIG/SOC2 - scan cadence + remediation records

Hi Sarah,

Thanks for the request — attached is the evidence bundle for FinLender's review.

Bundle contents (attachments and secure link):
- vm_scan_index_202506.csv (CSV export showing weekly and delta scans for the last 6 months)
- patch_manifest_202506.zip (ticket mappings and remediation notes; includes ticket IDs and owners)
- sla-declaration-2025-07.pdf (our SLA definitions and escalation policy)

We confirm there were no Critical CVEs affecting FinLender-scope production services in the last 90 days. For Critical CVEs (if they occur) our committed SLA is 30 days to remediation or documented emergency mitigation/deployment within 48 hours of active exploitation detection; system-level exceptions are tracked in the patch manifest.

Attestation (please use as-is in your binder):
"Redwood Inference attests that Critical CVEs affecting customer-production scopes are remediated or mitigated in accordance with our published SLA (Critical: 30 days; emergency mitigations within 48 hours when actively exploited). Exceptions, when approved, are documented in our patch manifest and retained for audit"

Link to files: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aB2c3ExampleLink
S3 location (internal): s3://redwood-secuments/finlender/2025-07/

Let me know if you need any further breakdown (per-region or per-cluster exports).

Regards,
Jonas

Redwood Inference

Jonas / Monica,

Received — thank you for the quick turnaround and clear attestation. The bundle looks complete for our SOC2 binder intake.

Two small follow-ups: 
1) Can you add an index file in the CSV with a short column that marks which scans were "customer-facing runtime" vs "internal infra-only"? That will help our reviewer.
2) Please preserve the patch_manifest ticket history for at least 12 months (we will reference a couple of ticket IDs during the walkthrough).

If you can drop an updated vm_scan_index_202506.csv with that extra column by Wed EOD (2025-07-16) that would be ideal. Otherwise this is good to include.

Best,
Sarah
